  • Method Details

    • modify

      protected StreamResource modify(Runnable mutation)
      Description copied from class: BasicResource
      Single mutation funnel for direct-field state changes on this bean.

      Each leaf's nested Unmodifiable snapshot overrides this method to throw. Mutators that delegate to the entity or header sub-beans are frozen by the BasicResource.freeze() deep-freeze of those sub-beans; this funnel additionally covers the direct-field BasicResource.setHeaders(HeaderList) reassignment.
